meta.title: PropBetEdge Boxing - historical-source and Hall of Fame source map
meta.method: Read-only: public pages via curl/WebFetch/WebSearch, a handful of requests per site; Wikidata SPARQL; MediaWiki API; loc.gov JSON API; archive.org metadata API; Smithsonian Open Access API with the public api.data.gov DEMO_KEY (no signup). No logins, signups, purchases or trials.
policy_reminders: BoxRec is BLOCKED: do not dereference or store Wikidata P1967 (BoxRec boxer ID) values, and do not ingest any fact whose only citation is boxrec.com.
Atomic facts only (person, hall, category, induction year, source URL, retrieved_at). Never copy biography prose, bout-record summaries or photos from hall sites.

hall_institutions.name: International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF)
hall_institutions.site_notes: HTTPS (port 443) refused connections on 2026-09-13; site is only reachable over plain HTTP. Built on Homestead. Not to be confused with boxinghalloffame.com (BHOF, Inc., a separate commercial film/photo licensing site).
hall_institutions.location: 1 Hall of Fame Drive, Canastota, NY 13032, USA
hall_institutions.induction_process_stated: Quoted from ibhof.com inductee index: "Members of the Boxing Writers Association of America and an international panel of boxing historians cast votes. Voters from Japan, England, Canada, Mexico, South Africa, Germany, Puerto Rico and the United States are among those who participate in the election process. An independent accounting firm tabulates the votes and the results are presented to the Hall. A news conference is held each year in December to announce the new class of inductees and the formal induction ceremony is held each year in June."
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: Not on category pages (alphabetical names only). Each inductee profile page has an 'Induction: YYYY' field, e.g. Muhammad Ali 'Induction: 1990', Yessica Chavez 'Induction: 2025'. Class-by-year can be rebuilt from the profile pages or from Wikidata P585.

category_page_headings: Pioneer - Last bout in or prior to 1892
Non-Participant - Those who have made contributions to the sport apart from roles as boxers or observers. ...
Observers - Print and media journalists, publishers, writers, historians, photographers, artists and screenwriters.
old_timer_sub_eras: "Early" era - Last bout no earlier than 1893; no later than 1942
"Late" era - Last bout no earlier than 1943; no later than 1988
eligibility_rules_quoted: Men's Modern Boxers ( Last bout no earlier than 1989 ) - Moderns enshrined 1990 to 2014 were elected under original criteria: Last bout no earlier than 1943.
Women's Modern Boxers ( Last bout no earlier than 1989 )
Men's Old-Timer Boxers ( Last bout no earlier than 1893; no later than 1988 ) - Old Timers enshrined 1990 to 2014: no later than 1942.
Women's Trailblazer Boxers ( Last bout no later than 1988)
Pioneer ( Last bout in or prior to 1892 )
categories_source_native.not_a_site_category: 'Women non-participants' is a Wikipedia grouping only. On ibhof.com, women such as Aileen Eaton and Kathy Duva are listed under Non-Participant.

inductee_counts_on_site.note: Counts are distinct profile-page links on each category page, retrieved 2026-09-13.

hall_institutions.page_format: Static HTML (Homestead). 7 category pages at /pages/about/inductees/{modern|women_modern|oldtimer|women_trailblazer|pioneer|nonparticipant|observer}.html, plus one profile per inductee at /pages/about/inductees/{category}/{slug}.html with Born/Died/Bouts/Won/Lost/Drew/KOs/Induction fields and prose biography.

hall_institutions.photos: Small inductee thumbnails (e.g. /pages/about/inductees/modern/ali.jpg) with no photographer credit or license. Treat as not reusable.

wikidata.p166_pattern: ?person p:P166 ?st . ?st ps:P166 wd:Q572227 ; pq:P585 ?pointInTime . References: P813 (retrieved) + P4474 (International Boxing Hall of Fame boxer ID, e.g. 'observer/neiman') or P854 ibhof.com URL.
wikidata.category_qualifier: none on the P166 statement. Category comes from the P4474 ID prefix (formatter URL http://www.ibhof.com/pages/about/inductees/$1.html).
wikidata.contamination_warning: About 351 awardee rows also carry P1967 (BoxRec boxer ID). Do not select or store it.

wikipedia_reconstruction.standalone_list_page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_International_Boxing_Hall_of_Fame_inductees returns HTTP 404. The inductees are listed inside the main article 'International Boxing Hall of Fame' (section 'Inductees').
wikipedia_reconstruction.table_format: Modern, Old Timers, Pioneers and the Women's sections use wikitables with Year | Inductees | Record | Nationality. Non-participants and Observers are bullet lists written as 'Name (YYYY)'.
discrepancies_found: Wikipedia is short of the site by about 11 Non-Participants and 12 Observers.
Al Bernstein is listed under Non-participants (2012) on Wikipedia but under Observer on ibhof.com.
wikipedia_reconstruction.record_column_warning: The Record column is probably derived from BoxRec. Do not ingest it.
wikipedia_reconstruction.license: Text is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 License. Bare facts (name, year, category) are not copyrightable, but copying the table structure or prose triggers CC BY-SA attribution and share-alike. Use Wikipedia only for discovery and cross-checking, never as the authority.
wikipedia_reconstruction.can_reconstruct_induction_facts: Partly. Wikidata (CC0) is the better route: complete (545), has a year for 543 and a category via P4474 that matches the site counts.

hall_institutions.automation_suitability: High. About 553 small static HTTP pages, stable slugs, low-rate crawl (1 request every few seconds) is enough. Plan: pull person + category + year from Wikidata, verify against each ibhof.com profile page's 'Induction:' field, and store the ibhof URL as provenance.

recommended_source_state_detail.ibhof.com: approved_reference (authoritative for its own category + induction year; capture atomic facts with URL only; no prose, records or photos; promoting (person, category, year) facts to approved_ingest needs an owner decision)

hall_institutions.name: World Boxing Hall of Fame (WBHF)
hall_institutions.location: Sacramento, CA, USA (revived). The original was Los Angeles-based, founded by Everett Sanders in 1980; its last ceremony was in 2010.
hall_institutions.induction_process_stated: Not stated. The site says 'A new Committee will be appointed'; the next ceremony, 'The Night of Champions', is on Saturday, October 24, 2026 in Sacramento.
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: One PDF, 'World Boxing Hall of Fame 1980-2010' (11 pages, about 411 name + year entries), grouped by role, not by class. The site says it was 'added from Archive.org (web.archive.org), reformatted'.
hall_institutions.page_format: GoDaddy site builder, one page plus PDF at img1.wsimg.com. The PDF text extracts but has broken wrapping and typos (e.g. 'Carmen Basillo', 'Chrley Burley').
hall_institutions.terms_copyright_quote: "Copyright (c) 2026 World Boxing Hall of Fame - All Rights Reserved."
hall_institutions.photos: None of inductees on the site. Not reusable.
hall_institutions.automation_suitability: Low to medium. One-time PDF parse, then manual cleanup. The list is itself a secondhand reconstruction from the Wayback Machine.

hall_institutions.name: Nevada Boxing Hall of Fame (NVBHOF)
hall_institutions.location: Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. 501(c)(3). The 2026 gala is at The Orleans Hotel and Casino, August 15.
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: Yes, one page per class: /2013 through /2024. The home page congratulates the 'Class of 2025 & 2026 Inductees', but no class page for those years was in the navigation.
hall_institutions.latest_year_note: Per-class pages run to 2024; the 2025 and 2026 classes are announced on the home page and in press (WBC, Fightnews).
hall_institutions.page_format: Wix. Text is server-rendered in the HTML, so no JS is needed to read names.
hall_institutions.robots_txt_quote:
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: *?lightbox=  (plus AdsBot rules, PetalBot Disallow: /, dotbot/AhrefsBot Crawl-delay: 10; Sitemap: https://www.nvbhof.com/sitemap.xml)
hall_institutions.terms_copyright_quote: "The official site of the Nevada Boxing Hall of Fame. (c)2026. All rights reserved."
hall_institutions.photos: Wix-hosted inductee images with no credits. Not reusable.
hall_institutions.automation_suitability: Medium. 12 to 14 small pages a year; parse the headings. Manual capture is fine at this volume.

hall_institutions.name: California Boxing Hall of Fame
hall_institutions.site_notes: No live official site. californiaboxinghalloffame.com does not resolve (DNS failure on 2026-09-13), and its last Wayback capture (2017-09-12) is an EarthLink parking page. The founder, Don Fraser, retired in 2018 and died in 2019. The inductions are only documented in press (WBC, BoxingScene, La Prensa, David Martinez Boxing).
hall_institutions.related: The National Boxing Hall of Fame (https://nationalboxinghalloffame.com/, Southern California, GoDaddy site; 'Copyright (c) 2023 National Boxing Hall of Fame LLC - All Rights Reserved.'; robots 'User-agent: * Disallow: /404'; Class of 2026 inducted April 2026) is a different organization founded by Bill Young. It is review_required and should not be treated as the California hall's successor without evidence.

hall_institutions.name: New Jersey Boxing Hall of Fame
hall_institutions.location: New Jersey, USA. Ceremonies are held at The Venetian, 546 River Drive, Garfield, NJ. The 55th Annual Induction & Award Ceremonies were on November 13, 2025, which implies the first ceremony was about 1970/71.
hall_institutions.induction_process_stated: Not stated on the pages read. Classes are announced by the president (Henry Hascup) in blog posts.
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: The master page 'Hall of Fame Inductees' is an alphabetical, all-caps list of about 800 names with NO years or categories. Year-by-class exists only as annual blog posts (about 2013 to 2026) with prose descriptions and some 'Posthumous' labels. Pre-2013 class years are not on the site.
categories_source_native: Hall of Famers (menu) / Hall of Fame Inductees (page title)
hall_institutions.earliest_year_note: Not visible on the site. The oldest class post seen is from about 2013; the hall itself dates to about 1970.
hall_institutions.terms_copyright_quote: "Copyright (c) 2026 New Jersey Boxing Hall of Fame . All Rights Reserved."
hall_institutions.photos: Ceremony photos credited in post titles (e.g. 'Photos taken by Ray Bailey'), many re-hosted from Facebook. Not reusable.
hall_institutions.automation_suitability: Medium for membership (one page). Low for class years (prose posts, only 2013+).

hall_institutions.name: Florida Boxing Hall of Fame (FBHOF)
hall_institutions.site_notes: HTTPS connection timed out; HTTP works. Built on Homestead.
hall_institutions.location: Florida, USA. Class announcements at SJC Boxing Gym, Fort Myers; induction weekend at Hilton Lake Carillon, St. Petersburg. The About page mentions a museum and the aim of a permanent museum in Tampa. 501(c)(3).
hall_institutions.induction_process_stated: The 'Induction Requirements' page is detailed. Examples: a boxer must have 'Won three (3) or more senior amateur titles, or ... two (2) or more senior national amateur titles, or ... Competed in at least five (5) main event contests in the professional ranks'; officials, managers, trainers and similar roles need 10 years of work; out-of-state boxers need 10 or more pro fights in Florida; 'All active boxers shall not be eligible'; 'Former boxers shall have been retired for at least five (5) years'; minimum criteria 'may be waived ... with a 100% vote by the Board of Directors'.
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: 'Previous Classes' is mostly IMAGES (CLASS_OF_2009.jpg to CLASS_OF_2020.jpg and per-inductee photos in year folders). There is no text roster, so reading it needs OCR or manual work. The home page shows Class of 2026 images; the Class of 2027 announcement is on January 2, 2027.
categories_source_native: Walter Flansburg Award (from file name WalterFlansburgAward2026.jpg)
hall_institutions.categories_note: No text category labels for inductees. Press coverage uses fighters / trainers / promoter / journalist / officials.
hall_institutions.earliest_year_note: Earliest class image on the site. The hall may be older; not verified.
hall_institutions.page_format: Homestead static HTML with image-based rosters.
hall_institutions.robots_txt_quote: Same Homestead default as IBHOF: User-agent: * Disallow: /~site/Scripts_ElementMailer ... Disallow: /~site/siteapps/showmap.action (roster pages not disallowed).
hall_institutions.terms_copyright_quote: No copyright or terms notice found in the home, About or Previous Classes page text.
hall_institutions.photos: Inductee and class photos with no credits or license. Not reusable.

hall_institutions.name: International Women's Boxing Hall of Fame (IWBHF)
hall_institutions.location: Started in Vancouver, Washington per Wikipedia, founded by Sue TL Fox / WBAN (womenboxing.com). Ceremonies since 2022 at the Orleans Hotel & Casino, Las Vegas; 2026 event on October 10, 2026.
hall_institutions.induction_process_stated: Not stated on iwbhf.com. Wikipedia (secondary) says a board of 11 members votes on nominees submitted by the public.
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: Yes. The home page lists 'Name - YYYY' entries (e.g. 'Barbara Buttrick - 2014', 'Laila Ali - 2015', 'Jane Couch - 2016'), with profile pages at /photosinductees/{slug}.htm. Later classes are announced in womenboxing.com press releases.
hall_institutions.page_format: Hand-built static HTML (.htm) plus press releases on womenboxing.com.
hall_institutions.terms_copyright_quote: No copyright or terms notice found in the home page text. The companion site womenboxing.com is a separate WBAN property; its terms were not checked.
hall_institutions.photos: Inductee photo pages with no license. Not reusable.
hall_institutions.automation_suitability: Medium: home page 'Name - YYYY' pairs are machine-readable; later years need the press releases.

hall_institutions.name: Women's Boxing Hall of Fame (generic name)
hall_institutions.note: No separate 'Women's Boxing Hall of Fame' was found. The name refers either to the IWBHF (above) or to IBHOF's 'Women's Modern' and 'Women's Trailblazer' categories (added with the Class of 2020).

hall_institutions.name: Canada's Sports Hall of Fame (boxing entries)
hall_institutions.location: 169 Canada Olympic Rd SW, Canada Olympic Park, Calgary, AB. The site says it 'is a virtual institution and not open to the Public'. Established 1955.
hall_institutions.induction_process_stated: "Selected from over 26,000 nominations by a committee comprised of sports broadcasters, writers, academics, and athletes, based on their ability to lead and inspire both on and off the field of play ..."
hall_institutions.inductee_list_by_year_or_class: Yes. The halloffamers.sportshall.ca page embeds JSON objects with fields member_name, last_name, member_name_slug, member_inducted, member_category, member_sport, default_image. 724 members in total, 18 with member_sport 'Boxing'.
hall_institutions.boxing_members_note: All 18 are category 'Athlete'. Names are listed as atomic facts only.
hall_institutions.year_note: Earliest and latest are for boxing members only.
hall_institutions.page_format: Plutonium CMS page with embedded JSON; main site on Webflow.
hall_institutions.terms_copyright_quote: "(c) 2025, CANADA'S SPORTS HALL OF FAME" plus 'Charitable Registration #118828631 RR0001'. No terms page read.
hall_institutions.photos: default_image values look like museum accession numbers (e.g. 'X981.513.1.3_u.jpg') with no license. Not reusable.

wikidata.p166_pattern: ?person p:P166/ps:P166 wd:Q1330014 ; wdt:P106 wd:Q11338576 (year mostly missing; take the year from the site JSON)

hall_institutions.related: Canadian Boxing Hall of Fame (Wikidata Q134052595, 3 P166 statements) exists but was not researched in depth.
hall_institutions.automation_suitability: High: one request returns structured JSON with the induction year.

hall_institutions.name: WBC hall/legends (WBC Legends of Boxing Museum)
hall_institutions.location: Los Angeles, CA (museum opened June 2008 per Wikipedia)
hall_institutions.note: A museum for past WBC champions, not an induction body. No inductee list or categories found. wbcboxing.com republishes other halls' class news (IBHOF, Nevada, New Jersey, California, IWBHF), which is useful for press-level corroboration only.

hall_institutions.name: WBA hall of fame / legends
hall_institutions.note: No WBA-run hall of fame found. wbaboxing.com only republishes news about other halls (e.g. Florida).

hall_institutions.name: The Ring magazine Hall of Fame (defunct)
hall_institutions.note: Historical hall run by The Ring, about 1954-1987 per Wikipedia. The only list found is on Wikipedia. No P166 statements on Wikidata. The Ring's own archive requires sign-up (see historical_sources).

hall_institutions.name: boxinghalloffame.com (BHOF, Inc.) - identity trap
hall_institutions.note: NOT the IBHOF. A commercial site that says it 'owns a vast library of rare film and photos that are available for licensing'. Its terms of use begin 'You must read and agree to these terms and conditions before you may access or view our Site'. It has a 'Hall of Famers' page but no verified induction process. Search engines mislabel it as the IBHOF's official site.

historical_sources.name: Wikidata
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Open. "All structured data from the main, Property, Lexeme, and EntitySchema namespaces is available under the Creative Commons CC0 License".

automation.api: SPARQL https://query.wikidata.org/sparql; Action API wbgetentities/wbsearchentities; weekly JSON dumps
automation.auth: none; send a descriptive User-Agent (Wikimedia UA policy)
automation.rate_limits: SPARQL 60 s query timeout, with throttling on heavy use (one aggregate query timed out during this research); prefer dumps for bulk

data_types: a small number of boxing-match items
historical_sources.boxrec_note: P1967 = 'BoxRec boxer ID' (formatter https://boxrec.com/en/boxer/$1). BoxRec is BLOCKED: never select, store, or follow P1967, and drop statements whose only reference is BoxRec. Bout data on boxing-match items should be treated as BoxRec-derived unless it has another reference.
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Store QID + property + value + qualifiers + statement GUID + revision ID + retrieved_at. Keep the statement's own references (P854/P4474) and verify against the originating institution where possible.
historical_sources.recommended_scope: Identity crosswalk and hall-award statements. Not bout records.

historical_sources.name: Wikipedia 'Professional boxing record' tables
historical_sources.rights_access_state: "Text is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 License". Facts are free, but reusing the tables or prose triggers BY-SA.

automation.api: MediaWiki Action API (action=parse&prop=wikitext|sections), REST API, dumps
automation.rate_limits: No hard published cap for reasonable serial use; robots.txt allows specific API paths

historical_sources.table_format: Section 'Professional boxing record' with a wikitable sortable of No. | Result | Record | Opponent | Type | Round | Date | Location | Notes (e.g. Harry Greb, Joe Louis). Some articles (e.g. Manny Pacquiao) move the record to a sub-article.
historical_sources.contamination_evidence: Harry Greb article: 25 BoxRec mentions against 47 <ref> tags. Joe Louis article: 42 BoxRec mentions (3 Cyber Boxing Zone). The record tables are largely BoxRec-derived.
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Discovery only. A bout row may enter review only if it cites a non-BoxRec primary source (newspaper page, commission record), and that primary source becomes the provenance, not Wikipedia.
historical_sources.recommended_scope: Treat as blocked for bulk bout ingestion because the tables are BoxRec-derived.

historical_sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
historical_sources.authority: tertiary (host of media; authority comes from the origin institution, e.g. LOC or NARA)
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Per-file licenses: PD, CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA. Machine-readable via imageinfo extmetadata (LicenseShortName, UsageTerms, Credit, AttributionRequired).

automation.rate_limits: Serial requests with maxlag; bulk via dumps

categories_checked.Category:Boxing posters: DOES NOT EXIST (only 'Category:Boxing posters of Poland', 3 files)
categories_checked.Category:Boxing in Madison Square Garden: DOES NOT EXIST (use 'Category:Madison Square Garden' and per-fight categories, e.g. 'Category:Muhammad Ali vs. Joe Frazier II')

historical_sources.temporal_coverage: All eras; the PD material is mostly before 1930
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Ingest only files whose license is Public domain or CC0 AND whose source links to an originating institution record (LOC LCCN, NARA NAID). Store the origin record as primary provenance and the Commons file as a mirror. CC BY/BY-SA files need review_required with an attribution plan.

LicenseShortName: "Public domain"; Credit: "U.S. National Archives and Records Administration"; date 1917-1918; photographer Committee on Public Information
LicenseShortName: "Public domain" (Template:PD-US); date 1917-01-01/1918-12-31; contributed by NARA via DPLA

historical_sources.recommended_scope: PD/CC0 files with a traceable institutional source only.

historical_sources.name: Library of Congress Prints & Photographs (loc.gov JSON API), incl. George Grantham Bain Collection
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Item-level rights_advisory. Bain items say: "No known restrictions on publication. For more information, see George Grantham Bain Collection - Rights and Restrictions Information https://www.loc.gov/rr/print/res/274_bain.html". General LOC statement: "The Library of Congress does not own rights to material in its collections. Therefore, it does not license or charge permission fees ..."

automation.api: loc.gov JSON API: append fo=json (e.g. /photos/?q=boxer&fa=partof:bain+collection&fo=json, /item/{lccn}/?fo=json). IIIF image service.
automation.auth: none ("The API is accessible to the public with no API key or authentication required. Rate limiting is strongly encouraged.")
automation.rate_limits: JSON/YAML API 20 requests/minute, 1-hour block if exceeded; Image Services 150/min; Text Services 150/min; MARCXML on lccn.loc.gov 30/min with a 72-hour block. 429s or CAPTCHAs are possible under load. robots.txt has Crawl-Delay: 5 and Disallow: /search and /pictures/search, so use /photos/, /collections/ and /item/ JSON endpoints.

historical_sources.temporal_coverage: Bain: roughly 1900-1920s (LOC often normalizes dates to e.g. 1910-01-01); P&P overall 1700s-present
historical_sources.geographic_coverage: Mostly USA (Bain is NYC-centric) plus international news subjects
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Store the LCCN, item URL, call number, rights_advisory verbatim and retrieved_at. Ingest media only when rights_advisory begins 'No known restrictions on publication'. Treat LOC titles and dates as catalog metadata, not as verified bout facts.

historical_sources.name: Chronicling America (LOC historic newspapers)
historical_sources.authority: primary (contemporaneous newspaper reports of bouts and results)
historical_sources.rights_access_state: "The Library of Congress believes that the newspapers in Chronicling America are in the public domain or have no known copyright restrictions. Newspapers published in the United States more than 95 years ago are in the public domain in their entirety. ..." (item JSON 'rights' field)

automation.api: loc.gov JSON API only. The legacy Chronicling America API was retired when the site migrated to loc.gov (transition completed August 4, 2025). Example: /collections/chronicling-america/?q=prize+fight&dates=1890/1922&fo=json
automation.rate_limits: Same loc.gov limits: 20 JSON requests/minute (1-hour block); text services 150/min; deep paging is limited

historical_sources.temporal_coverage: About 1756-1963 per LOC (not re-verified this pass). US public domain applies in full to issues published before 1931 as of 2026.
historical_sources.geographic_coverage: USA (state partners under the National Digital Newspaper Program)
stable_identifiers: LCCN sn-number + date + edition + sequence (e.g. sn82014248/1910-07-07/ed-1/?sp=12)
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Every bout fact extracted from OCR must cite the page URL + sequence and the OCR text span, and be human-verified (OCR errors). Auto-ingest pages dated before 1931; review later pages.

historical_sources.name: Internet Archive (archive.org)
historical_sources.authority: mixed: hosts primary texts (19th/early-20th-c. boxing books, Police Gazette issues) and secondary books
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Per-item metadata, mostly uploader-asserted. Institutional scans carry 'possible-copyright-status: NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT' and 'copyright-evidence'. Community uploads may carry 'licenseurl' (e.g. PD Mark 1.0) or nothing. Modern in-copyright books are in 'inlibrary'/'printdisabled' lending collections, which are not open.

automation.rate_limits: No published hard cap; robots.txt is minimal (Disallow: /control/, /report/). Keep serial and polite.

historical_sources.geographic_coverage: Global (UK and US heavy for pugilism literature)
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Ingest only items published before 1931 with institutional copyright-evidence or a clear PD date. Treat uploader-set licenseurl as a claim needing review. Exclude user uploads of post-1930 magazines (e.g. 'the-ring-april-1963' has no rights field and a personal uploader). Cite identifier + page (leaf) number for every fact.

historical_sources.name: Digital Public Library of America (DPLA)
historical_sources.authority: tertiary (aggregator of hubs such as NARA and state digital libraries)
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Item rights come from contributors as rightsstatements.org/CC URIs (a web facet 'Unlimited Re-Use' exists). DPLA metadata is reportedly released CC0, but the policy page could not be read from this network (connection reset).

automation.auth: api_key REQUIRED, obtained by HTTP POST to https://api.dp.la/v2/api_key/{email}; the key is emailed back
automation.rate_limits: "access to the API will not ordinarily be rate-limited or revoked" (DPLA policy, via search snippet)

historical_sources.access_problem: dp.la and api.dp.la reset connections from this network on 2026-09-13.
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Use DPLA only to discover items. Resolve to the contributing institution's record and rights statement, and store that as provenance.

historical_sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
historical_sources.authority: primary (museum objects: tickets, postcards, documents, photographs) with curatorial metadata
historical_sources.rights_access_state: CC0 is decided PER MEDIA FILE (API field content.descriptiveNonRepeating.online_media.media[].usage.access == "CC0"). TRAP: web pages show 'Metadata Usage CC0' even when the image is restricted. Example: American Amateur Boxing Album (nmah_1072598) page says "There are restrictions for re-using this image. For more information, visit the Smithsonian's Terms of Use page" (container class media--no-openaccess), yet its Metadata Usage is CC0.

automation.auth: api.data.gov key. Normal use needs signup (owner approval required); the public DEMO_KEY worked for a few low-rate calls in this research
automation.rate_limits: DEMO_KEY is heavily limited by api.data.gov (about 30/hour, 50/day; not re-verified). Bulk alternative with no key: GitHub Smithsonian/OpenAccess (11M+ metadata records, line-delimited JSON, bz2).
automation.web_access_note: si.edu object pages and collections.si.edu often return HTTP 403 'Smithsonian request verification' to scripts. Do not scrape; use the bulk data.

historical_sources.search_quirk: The API matches stemmed terms ('boxing' also matches 'box', 'ballot box'). Filter on title or topic after retrieval.

measured_counts.note: That count is inflated by stemming.

historical_sources.provenance_policy: Store record_ID, ARK, media usage.access verbatim, unit_code and retrieved_at. Ingest media only when usage.access == CC0 at the media level.

historical_sources.name: National Archives Catalog (NARA)
historical_sources.authority: primary (federal records: military boxing, WWI Committee on Public Information photos, Signal Corps, etc.)
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Federal government works are generally public domain; donated materials can be restricted, so check per record. Catalog web UI is a JavaScript SPA.

automation.auth: API key REQUIRED: "An assigned API key must be incorporated into each API request." Obtained by emailing Catalog_API@nara.gov
automation.rate_limits: Default 10,000 queries/month per key (higher tiers 150,000; staff 500,000; partners 1,500,000). Exceeding it blocks the key until next month.

historical_sources.provenance_policy: Store the NAID, local ID, record group, use-restriction fields and retrieved_at. Use Commons NARA-cooperation mirrors for discovery only.

historical_sources.name: New York State Archives: State Athletic Commission records

series.title: New York State Athletic Commission Boxing and Wrestling Event (Show) Files
series.content: Summary sheets listing event participants and results; judges' score cards by round; attendance and tax receipts (per finding-aid snippet)

series.title: New York State Athletic Commission Boxing History Record Cards
series.content: Fight records of about 5,000 boxers licensed in New York: given and professional name, birth date, address, chronological fights, opponents, results, judges and referee, manager, dates of mandatory inactivity (per snippet)

series.title: New York State Athletic Commission General Bulletins
State Athletic Commission Minutes
series.content: Partly digitized in NYSA Digital Collections (e.g. Minutes January-May 1945, object 74164)

historical_sources.rights_access_state: Not captured. findingaids.nysed.gov returned HTTP 401 behind an Anubis proof-of-work bot challenge; digitalcollections.archives.nysed.gov showed a robot-verification gate; iarchives.nysed.gov timed out. Records contain personal data (addresses, birth dates), so expect access restrictions on recent material.
historical_sources.temporal_coverage: Commission era, 1920s onward (exact series dates not captured)
historical_sources.geographic_coverage: New York State (Madison Square Garden, etc.)
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Manual research only: reading room or reproduction request. Cite series, box/folder and item. Very high value for verifying NY bouts independently of BoxRec.

historical_sources.name: California State Archives: Department of Consumer Affairs - State Athletic Commission Records
historical_sources.content: 30.5 cubic feet, 1925-1991 per inventory text (the OAC title reads 'Records, 1913-1934', a discrepancy to resolve). Series include License Files ('applications of over 1,000 boxers'), event reports, correspondence, Club Tax Journals, Account Books, Fees Received Journals. The SOS exhibit uses F2214 for Henry Armstrong's Boxing License Renewal Application (all per search snippets).
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Per inventory snippet: some records restricted under the Information Practices Act or Public Records Act; under California Government Code section 12237, after January 1, 2005 all items 75 years old or older on deposit are publicly accessible. OAC returned HTTP 202 with an empty body to scripted access.
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Manual, in-person or reproduction request. Cite F-number, box and folder. Only materials 75+ years old are generally open.

historical_sources.name: Cyber Boxing Zone (CBZ) and similar fan encyclopedias
historical_sources.authority: tertiary (volunteer-compiled records and encyclopedia; staff historians named on the home page)
historical_sources.rights_access_state: No license or reuse statement found on the home page. robots.txt does not exist (returns a 'File Not Found' HTML page). Compilations are copyrightable in selection and arrangement, and sourcing is unclear and may overlap with BoxRec-era data.
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Do not ingest. At most, use as a research lead that must be confirmed in a primary source (newspaper or commission record).

historical_sources.name: The Ring magazine archive
historical_sources.rights_access_state: Copyrighted publisher archive. Full-issue digital access requires creating an account ('you must sign up to see it for free'), and a paid digital subscription is also sold. Under the zero-signup rule this is not allowed. Copies on the Internet Archive are unlicensed user uploads (e.g. 'the-ring-april-1963': no rights field, personal uploader).
historical_sources.temporal_coverage: 1922-present (issues from 1922-1930 are US public domain by date, but must come from a legitimate library copy, not the gated platform or unlicensed uploads)
historical_sources.provenance_policy: Do not ingest. Pre-1931 issues from a library holding may be reviewed item by item.
